description: Compact the admin Settings menu by grouping 19 settings items into sub-categories (Payment Settings, Channel Settings, Shop Settings, System Settings). Also perform a code audit to fix any issues introduced by the prior 3 features (broken references, orphaned code, missing state handlers).
steps: Group SETTINGS_MAP into sub-categories. Create new button constants for settings sub-menus: BTN_SET_PAYMENT = _b('💳 Payment Settings'), BTN_SET_CHANNELS = _b('📣 Channel Settings'), BTN_SET_SHOP = _b('🏪 Shop Settings'), BTN_SET_SYSTEM = _b('🔧 System Settings')
Redesign admin_settings_kb() to show only 4-5 category buttons plus Back/Home instead of all 19 items
Create sub-keyboards for each settings category that shows only the relevant items
Add FSM states for settings sub-menus (AdminFlow.settings_payment, settings_channels, settings_shop, settings_system) or reuse settings_menu with data-based routing
Add handlers for the new settings category buttons that show the sub-keyboard
Ensure the existing settings_edit handler still works - it reads from SETTINGS_MAP so the actual setting items must still be accessible from their sub-keyboards
Code audit: Check for any broken references to removed functions (get_referral_surcharge, _inline_row, _paginate_inline, removed callback handlers). Grep for any orphaned references.
Code audit: Verify all admin handlers that moved to sub-menus still work correctly - check that their state filters match the new sub-menu states
Code audit: Ensure the fav_add callback that was in admin contexts (if any) still works - admin inline keyboards were kept
acceptance_criteria: Admin settings shows category buttons (4-5) instead of 19 items on first screen
All 19 settings items are still accessible through their category sub-menus
No broken function references in the codebase
verification: grep 'admin_settings_kb' bot.py should show the redesigned compact function
grep 'get_referral_surcharge' bot.py should return no matches (confirming cleanup)
